diagram_previews.alt: A 5 by 5 square with gray 1 by 1 squares cut from its corners. A blue tilted square has one vertex on each side of the 5 by 5 square; each of its sides passes through an inner corner of a cut-out square (marked with dots, one labelled P). Along the bottom side the segments to the left and right of the tilted square's vertex are labelled a and 5 - a.
